title: Expense tracker with running total
describe: an expense tracker with a total
prompt:
Build an expense tracker at /.

Requirements:
- A heading "Expenses".
- A field labelled "Description", a number field labelled "Amount" and a button "Add expense". Adding appends a row and clears both fields. An empty description or an amount that is not above zero shows the error "Enter a description and an amount above zero" and adds nothing.
- Each row shows the description and the amount with two decimals, for example $4.50, and has a button "Delete <description>", for example "Delete Coffee".
- A line "Total: $<sum>" with two decimals, "Total: $0.00" when empty.
- Keep it all on the client; there is no server.

steps.text: Enter a description and an amount above zero
